---
title: "📦 ae12-iv"
subtitle: "Instrumental variables with quarter-of-birth data"
---

The exercise and two sets of worked solutions, built on Angrist and Krueger's returns-to-schooling data. Belongs to [Instrumental variables](../topics/60-instrumental-variables.qmd).

```{=html}
<p><a class="mp-download" href="/ae/ae12-iv.zip" download>⬇ Download ae12-iv.zip</a></p>
```

:::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Unzip it, then open the `.Rproj` file in RStudio. Every path inside the exercises is relative to that project, so the data will load without edits.
::::
